title.zh: 看見思考軌跡：AI 數學同伴
title.en: Making Thinking Visible: AI Mathematics Companion

category.zh: 碩士論文 · 網頁應用

summary.zh: 整合互動畫布與多代理 AI 的數學解題系統。學生可用手寫、繪圖與文字表達思考，系統將畫布內容與近期對話交給 AI 分析，再依推估的解題階段調整引導。
summary.en: A mathematics problem-solving system combining an interactive canvas and multiple AI agents. Students express their reasoning through handwriting, drawings, and text; the system analyzes the canvas and recent dialogue to adapt guidance to an estimated problem-solving stage.

role.zh: 獨立完成前端互動畫布、PHP／MySQL 後端、AI 代理協作、提示詞策略及功能整合。研究問卷與量表參考學長姊的研究工具及過往文獻。
role.en: Independently built the interactive canvas, PHP/MySQL backend, AI-agent coordination, prompt strategies, and feature integration. Study questionnaires and scales drew on instruments used by senior research-group members and prior literature.

coverAlt.zh: mathai 操作介面：左側呈現數學題目，中央畫布保留手寫與繪圖，右側顯示 AI 引導對話。
coverAlt.en: The mathai interface: a mathematics task on the left, handwriting and drawings on the central canvas, and AI guidance on the right.

body.zh:
國小高年級的幾何文字應用題，往往需要畫圖、列式與反覆修正，單靠文字對話不容易表達完整的推理。我希望學生能保留紙筆解題的自由度，並讓 AI 參考當下的圖形、算式、文字與修正歷程。

系統定位為能反覆提問、陪伴學生思考的數學同伴。階段提示是調整引導方向的依據，目前仍屬待驗證的模型推估。
body.en:
Geometric word problems often require drawings, equations, and repeated revisions that are difficult to express through text alone. I wanted to preserve the flexibility of paper-based work while letting AI refer to students’ current drawings, equations, and messages.

The system is designed as a companion for repeated questions and reasoning. Stage labels guide the response strategy; they are model estimates, not validated diagnoses of a student’s abilities.

body.zh:
介面把題目、互動畫布與 AI 對話放在同一畫面。學生可自由書寫、繪製直線與幾何圖形、調整顏色與筆觸、擦除及縮放拖曳，也能上傳紙筆照片。

每次送出訊息時，系統會擷取目前畫布影像，連同文字與近期對話交由 AI 分析。回應呈現後更新互動紀錄；學生可以繼續修改畫布、補充想法，再進行下一輪對話。
body.en:
Tasks, the interactive canvas, and AI dialogue share one interface. Students can write freely, draw lines and geometric shapes, change colors and stroke widths, erase, pan and zoom, and upload photographs of paper-based work.

Each submitted message is accompanied by a canvas snapshot and recent dialogue for AI analysis. Interaction records are updated after the response, allowing students to revise their work and continue the conversation.

body.zh:
前端以 JavaScript 與 Fabric.js 提供畫布工具；後端以 PHP 串接 AI API，並由 MySQL 保存題庫、對話、畫布狀態與操作事件。操作日誌記錄時間、工具類型及物件新增、修改、刪除，支援研究期間的歷程分析；目前的事件紀錄仍不足以完整重建每一筆作圖順序。

AI 分成「數學思考狀態分析師」與「數學 AI 小幫手」：前者整合圖文與近期脈絡，推估學生處於題意理解、策略執行或結果反思；後者組合核心提示詞、階段提示詞與題目內容，生成相應的提問。
body.en:
JavaScript and Fabric.js provide the canvas tools. A PHP backend connects to the AI API, while MySQL stores tasks, dialogue, canvas states, and activity events. Logs record time, tool type, and object additions, changes, and deletions for process analysis, although they do not yet reconstruct every drawing action in sequence.

A mathematical-thinking analyst combines visual and textual context to estimate the problem-solving stage. A separate AI helper combines core instructions, stage-specific prompts, and task content to generate guidance.

body.zh:
實作需要把畫布、對話與學習引導接在一起，讓回應能參考當下的解題內容。提示詞除了要求不直接給答案，也限制回應長度與提問數量，並把不同階段轉成「尋找線索」、「動手建造」與「筆記大師」等介面標籤。

實際使用時，學生會反覆索取答案或把對話帶離數學任務。我依互動紀錄調整核心提示詞，補上任務範圍與回應規則。這次迭代提供了改進方向，對不同輸入情境的穩定性仍需持續檢驗。
body.en:
The challenge was connecting the canvas, dialogue, and instructional guidance. Prompts limit response length and question count as well as discourage revealing answers. Estimated stages are presented through student-facing labels for finding clues, working through the problem, and reflecting on results.

During use, students repeatedly requested answers or redirected the conversation away from mathematics. I revised the core prompts using interaction records to clarify task boundaries and response rules. This iteration does not establish that all off-task inputs are prevented.

body.zh:
完成可供研究使用的整套系統，並以四週使用歷程觀察 9 名五年級學生的互動。主要觀察到文字與畫布並行的表達方式，包含繪圖、算式、標記及修正。

數學自我效能與數學焦慮量表的前後測差異未達統計顯著，不能據此宣稱系統能提升能力或降低焦慮。後續重點是以人工編碼驗證階段推估、改善不規則筆跡理解，以及讓回應更具體地對應學生的實際作答，減少重複制式的鼓勵。
body.en:
Delivered a complete system for a four-week exploratory study with nine fifth graders. Observations focused on interactions combining text and canvas activity, including drawings, equations, annotations, and revisions.

Pre–post differences in mathematics self-efficacy and anxiety were not statistically significant. The study therefore does not establish improved ability or reduced anxiety. Further work includes validating stage estimates against human coding, improving irregular-handwriting interpretation, and grounding responses in students’ actual work rather than repetitive encouragement.

title.en: BioUtopia · Dreaming about Health and Biology

category.zh: 大學專題 · TAECT 2022 第四名

summary.zh: 把人體器官轉化為可探索的生活場景，結合劇情、細胞角色與四種遊戲關卡，讓國一生物和健康教育內容融入第一人稱 RPG。獲 TAECT 2022 數位媒體實作競賽第四名，並於 TWELF 2023 發表。
summary.en: A first-person RPG that maps human organs to familiar places. Storytelling, cell characters, and four types of game challenges bring together Grade 7 biology and health education. It received fourth place at TAECT 2022 and was presented at TWELF 2023.

role.zh: 負責大量 Unity 場景製作與 C# 程式撰寫，也整理國一生物課綱、學習題目與數位教育研究，和組員共同完成遊戲。
role.en: Built many Unity scenes and wrote C# code. Prepared curriculum content, questions, and digital education research with teammates to complete the game.

coverAlt.zh: BioUtopia 骨髓場景：以城鎮與細胞角色呈現人體器官的類比學習，畫面包含引導對話。
coverAlt.en: The BioUtopia bone-marrow scene, using a town, cell characters, and dialogue to present an analogy for learning about the human body.

body.zh:
人體細胞與器官功能不容易只靠課本文字理解，生物與健康教育也常分開學習。專案以國一課程為範圍，把養分、運輸、協調、恆定與拒絕成癮的內容放進同一段冒險。

類比是場景設計的核心。例如，骨髓以「細胞誕生之地」連結幼兒園的概念；角色對話再說明生活場景與器官功能之間的對應。設計重點在於讓生活場景與要學的器官功能有清楚對應。
body.en:
Cell and organ functions can be difficult to understand from textbook descriptions, while biology and health topics are often taught separately. The project connects Grade 7 content on nutrition, transport, coordination, homeostasis, and addiction prevention within one adventure.

Analogy drives the setting design: for example, bone marrow is introduced as a place where cells are born and compared with a kindergarten. Dialogue explains the mapping. These analogies support understanding without replacing a full biological explanation.

body.zh:
玩家在夢境中遇見小精靈，以第一人稱探索人體器官的類比場景。靠近細胞角色時出現對話，先理解場景中的知識，再把內容用於關卡。完成主要關卡後可返回先前場景，結束時提供回饋表單及是否儲存遊戲的選項。

團隊安排四種關卡：翻牌配對細胞資訊、選擇題、限時穿越正確門的是非題，以及隱藏的打地鼠。不同關卡採不同計分與通關條件，讓學習題目成為遊戲行動的一部分。
body.en:
Players meet a guide in a dream and explore organ-inspired settings from a first-person perspective. Approaching cell characters opens dialogue; knowledge from each scene is then used in game challenges. After the main challenges, players can revisit earlier scenes and access feedback and save options.

The team created four challenge types: matching cell-information cards, multiple-choice questions, timed true/false gates, and a hidden whack-a-mole game. Each uses different scoring and progression rules.

caption.zh: 翻牌配對關卡把細胞名稱、角色與功能說明放進可操作的題目。
caption.en: The matching challenge combines cell names, characters, and functional descriptions in an interactive task.

body.zh:
以 Unity 組裝場景、角色、對話框、圖片與動畫，再以 C# 處理角色互動、事件觸發及關卡進程。教材中的知識需要轉成玩家能看見、操作或回答的內容。

專案整合 Unity Asset Store、Sketchfab 與自行製作的素材，角色設計使用 3ds Max、Mixamo，語音採 Azure 文字轉語音。這些是團隊的素材與工具配置；我的主要負責範圍是場景、程式及學習內容。
body.en:
Unity integrates scenes, characters, dialogue, images, and animation. C# handles character interactions, event triggers, and level progression. Curriculum concepts are translated into things players can observe, operate, or answer.

The team combined Unity Asset Store and Sketchfab assets with its own materials, used 3ds Max and Mixamo for characters, and Azure text-to-speech for voices. My main responsibilities were scenes, code, and learning content.

body.zh:
需要同時顧到教材對應、遊戲節奏與程式規則。例如，選擇題答錯後移除該選項，直到答對才繼續；是非題則加入限時與全數答對的通關條件。同樣是題目，互動與回饋方式會隨關卡改變。

開發時依階段安排組員互相試玩，再調整故事、介面與程式錯誤。類比關係也需要透過對話說清楚，避免玩家只記住場景名稱，卻沒有理解要學的概念。
body.en:
Development had to balance curriculum mappings, pacing, and progression rules. Incorrect multiple-choice options disappear until the correct answer is chosen, while true/false gates add time limits and require all answers to be correct. Feedback differs by challenge.

Team members tested completed stages and revised the story, interface, and bugs. Dialogue also needed to make each analogy explicit so players could connect the setting with the intended concept.

body.zh:
完成包含學習場景、角色對話與四種關卡的教育 RPG，獲 TAECT 2022 數位媒體實作競賽第四名，並以「以類比學習為基礎開發之國中生物與健康跨領域角色扮演遊戲」於 TWELF 2023 發表。

TWELF 2023 論文記錄的是遊戲開發與設計，當時尚未進行教學實驗；遊戲的學習成效仍待實證評估。
body.en:
Completed an educational RPG with learning scenes, character dialogue, and four challenge types. It received fourth place in the TAECT 2022 digital media competition and was presented at TWELF 2023.

The TWELF 2023 paper reports game development and design before a classroom experiment had been conducted. Learning effectiveness still requires empirical evaluation.

title.zh: 前進元宇宙教育：探索沉浸式 VR 合作學習的全新可能
title.en: Advancing metaverse education: Exploring new possibilities of immersive VR-based collaborative learning

category.zh: 國科會計畫 · Unity／VRChat SDK 開發
category.en: NSTC research project · Unity/VRChat SDK development

summary.zh: 以 Unity／VRChat SDK 建置支援多人互動的沉浸式學習環境，結合國中 STEM 與 SDGs。以氣候行動的小島場景為例，學生可探索海平面上升議題，並在環境中討論、整理想法。
summary.en: An immersive learning environment built with Unity and the VRChat SDK to support multi-user interaction around junior-high STEM and the SDGs. An island scene for climate action lets students explore sea-level rise and discuss their ideas within the environment.

role.zh: 主導 Unity／VRChat SDK 學習環境開發，與一位協作者討論需求、拆分工作並整合成果；負責把計畫中的學習情境做成可操作的虛擬場景。
role.en: Led the Unity/VRChat SDK environment development with one collaborator, discussing requirements, dividing tasks, and integrating the work into usable virtual learning scenes.

coverAlt.zh: Unity 中的 VRChat 小島學習場景開發畫面，右側可見 VRChat SDK 設定。
coverAlt.en: Development of an island learning scene in Unity, with VRChat SDK settings visible on the right.

body.zh:
國科會計畫希望建立沉浸式 VR 合作學習的模式，並在後續階段研究合作鷹架。我的開發工作聚焦學習環境：學生除了各自看見場景，也需要能在同一虛擬世界中交流與合作。

GCCCE 2024 論文以國中八年級教材、STEM 與 SDGs 為設計基礎，把永續議題轉成可探索、討論及反思的學習情境。
body.en:
The NSTC project aims to establish models for immersive VR collaborative learning and investigate collaboration scaffolds in later phases. My development work focused on an environment where students can communicate and collaborate in a shared virtual world.

The GCCCE 2024 paper uses Grade 8 content, STEM, and the SDGs to turn sustainability issues into situations for exploration, discussion, and reflection.

body.zh:
學生使用 Meta Quest 2 進入 VRChat 的虛擬環境，以化身探索場景，透過語音與同伴交流。學習內容結合多媒體素材與互動物件，讓小組可觀察、表達及統整想法。

氣候行動場景以小型海島國為例，呈現海平面上升相關內容，搭配影片、照片及圖表，引導學生討論溫室氣體、能源選擇與生活中的環境行動。畫筆、便利貼與拼圖是論文中用來支持表達及整理想法的互動設計。
body.en:
Students enter the VRChat environment using Meta Quest 2, explore as avatars, and communicate with peers through voice. Multimedia and interactive objects support observation, expression, and organizing ideas.

The climate-action example is a small island setting with material on sea-level rise, greenhouse gases, energy choices, and everyday environmental actions. The paper describes pens, sticky notes, and puzzles as ways to support expression and discussion.

body.zh:
以 Unity 製作虛擬場景，再透過 VRChat SDK 串接平台功能及頭戴式裝置體驗。場景內容、互動素材與多人交流需要一起考慮，才能把學習活動放進實際可用的環境。

論文比較多種虛擬平台後採用 VRChat，考量包含多人交流、Unity SDK 的開發彈性與裝置支援。這些需求共同形成當時的選型依據。
body.en:
Unity provides the virtual scenes, while the VRChat SDK connects them with platform features and headset-based use. Scene content, interactive materials, and multi-user communication are considered together.

The paper selected VRChat after comparing several virtual platforms, considering communication, Unity SDK flexibility, and device support. These describe the selection at that time, not a current feature comparison.

body.zh:
合作學習的場景需要支援共同討論與想法整理，互動方式也是場景設計的一部分。我把需求拆成場景與互動工作，和協作者討論各自負責的內容，再整合到同一學習環境。

頭戴式裝置的操作適應、網路連線與平台更新，也會影響使用與研究安排。GCCCE 2024 論文將這些列為限制；後續需透過實際裝置操作與使用紀錄評估體驗。
body.en:
Collaborative learning requires a space for shared discussion, beyond a single-user 3D presentation. I divided scene and interaction work with the collaborator and integrated the results into one environment.

Headset familiarity, connectivity, and platform updates can affect use. The GCCCE 2024 paper identifies these limitations; device-based testing and usage records are needed to assess the experience.

body.zh:
完成 Unity／VRChat SDK 學習環境的開發協作，相關設計以「支持學生於元宇宙社交互動並結合 STEM 與 SDGs 的沉浸式虛擬實境學習環境開發」於 GCCCE 2024 發表。後續教授的期刊論文也在誌謝中記錄這項開發協作。

GCCCE 2024 論文記錄的是環境設計與開發，發表時尚未完成實證研究。這個階段的成果是虛擬場景、互動設計與平台整合；學習成效仍需另外驗證。
body.en:
Completed the Unity/VRChat SDK environment development collaboration. The design was presented at GCCCE 2024, and a later journal paper acknowledged the development contribution.

The GCCCE 2024 paper reports environment design and development before an empirical study had been completed. Virtual scenes, interaction design, and platform integration are the development outcomes; learning effectiveness requires separate evaluation.

title.zh: VR 內容共創學習活動

summary.zh: 參與「後疫情時代支持學生進行 VR 內容共創學習活動之活動設計、腳本研發與成效評估」專題研究計畫。
summary.en: Participated in an NSTC project on activity design, script development, and effectiveness evaluation for students’ VR content co-creation learning in the post-COVID-19 era.

role.zh: 協助研究群學長姊製作 CoSpaces 數位教育遊戲，內容以國小高年級 STEAM 專題為主，並協助小學場域的 VR 合作學習實驗。
role.en: Assisted senior research-group members in creating CoSpaces educational games for upper-elementary STEAM projects and supported a VR collaborative-learning experiment at an elementary school.

coverAlt.zh: VR 共創學習活動畫面

body.zh:
參與陳政煥教授的學習與教學科技研究群（LIT Research Group），協助「後疫情時代支持學生進行 VR 內容共創學習活動之活動設計、腳本研發與成效評估」研究計畫。

個人工作包括與學長姊共同製作 CoSpaces 教育遊戲，以及支援小學 VR 合作學習實驗。
body.en:
As a member of the LIT Research Group, I supported an NSTC project on activity design, collaboration scripts, and evaluation for VR content co-creation.

My contributions included creating CoSpaces educational games with senior members and supporting an elementary-school VR collaborative-learning experiment.

body.zh: 在多媒體數位學習與行動學習課程中接觸 CoSpaces 與 MAKAR，製作 XR 數位教育遊戲，後續將 CoSpaces 經驗運用於研究群的合作學習素材。
body.en: Used CoSpaces and MAKAR in multimedia and mobile learning courses to create XR educational games, later applying CoSpaces experience to collaborative-learning materials in the research group.

title.zh: AI CUP 2022 農作物影像辨識

category.zh: 深度學習競賽 · Private Leaderboard 第 37／151 名
category.en: Deep learning competition · 37th of 151 on the private leaderboard

summary.zh: 使用 Python 與 PyTorch 參與 AI CUP 2022 農地作物現況調查影像辨識競賽春季賽，團隊 Private Leaderboard 得分 0.9838242，151 隊中排名第 37 名，位居前 25%。
summary.en: Used Python and PyTorch in the spring AI CUP 2022 crop image classification competition. The team scored 0.9838242 on the private leaderboard, ranking 37th of 151 teams in the top quarter.

role.zh: 主要負責理解與整合訓練程式，處理訓練集輸入、模型建立、模型評估及測試集結果輸出；資料集人工篩選由組員共同完成，其他組員也提供整理後的資料與訓練設備。
role.en: Primarily understood and integrated the training workflow, handling training-data input, model construction, evaluation, and test-result output. Teammates jointly curated the dataset and provided prepared data and training hardware.

body.zh: 先在人工智慧概論課程接觸 TensorFlow 與 Python，之後於深度學習課程學習 PyTorch，透過課程資源、錄影回放與週六競賽工作坊準備 AI CUP。
body.en: I first studied TensorFlow and Python in an introductory AI course, then learned PyTorch in a deep learning course. Course resources, recorded lectures, and Saturday workshops supported competition preparation.

heading.zh: 資料規模與影像前處理

body.zh: 訓練集超過 80,000 張圖片、約 157 GB，不能直接完整投入訓練。團隊先把影像裁切為 512×512，保留具有明顯作物特徵的區域，再依作物位置與背景干擾人工篩選；第一版模型後，又針對表現較弱的胡蘿蔔、玉米、火龍果、花生、南瓜與黃豆整理第二版資料集。
body.en: The training set contained more than 80,000 images and about 157 GB of data, so it could not be used directly. The team cropped images to 512×512 regions with visible crop features, then manually filtered background noise and created a second dataset for weaker classes such as carrot, corn, dragon fruit, peanut, pumpkin, and soybean.

body.zh: 在 Anaconda 的 Python／PyTorch 環境中，先以 InceptionV3 訓練，再以整理後的資料進行 InceptionV3 與 EfficientNet-B0 的遷移式訓練。測試影像也會切成 20 份進行評估，從可能預測錯誤的結果回頭整理資料，最後再訓練 EfficientNet-B2。
body.en: In an Anaconda Python/PyTorch environment, the team first trained InceptionV3, then used the curated data for transfer learning with InceptionV3 and EfficientNet-B0. Test images were also split into 20 crops for evaluation; likely errors were reviewed and used to train a final EfficientNet-B2 model.

body.zh: 我的程式工作涵蓋訓練集輸入、模型建立、測試集評估與結果輸出。團隊將 InceptionV3、EfficientNet-B0 與 EfficientNet-B2 的輸出 CSV 再交給 XGBoost 集成，產生最後的 submit_X2.csv；Private Leaderboard 得分為 0.9838242，151 隊中排名第 37 名。
body.en: My code work covered training input, model construction, test evaluation, and result output. The team fed the CSV outputs from InceptionV3, EfficientNet-B0, and EfficientNet-B2 into XGBoost to create submit_X2.csv. The private leaderboard score was 0.9838242, ranking 37th of 151 teams.

body.zh: 檢查結果時發現南瓜是較弱的類別，雜草背景可能與南瓜葉相似，影響 F1-score。團隊也曾訓練其他模型，但完成時已超過上傳期限，因此無法確認是否改善最終成績。
body.en: Pumpkin was a weaker class during error review, partly because weed backgrounds could resemble pumpkin leaves and reduce the F1 score. The team also trained additional models, but they finished after the submission deadline, so their effect on the final result could not be confirmed.

title.zh: 個人網站與部落格建置

category.zh: 自主學習 · 網頁建置

summary.zh: 從高中使用 Blogger 記錄生活，到大學使用 WordPress 建立個人網站，持續學習網頁呈現、內容管理與資料庫基礎。
summary.en: From blogging with Blogger in high school to building a WordPress site at university, I developed experience with web presentation, content management, and database fundamentals.

role.zh: 自行探索免費架站資源、建立與調整個人部落格；學習 PHP、MySQL、HTML5 與 CSS，整理科技及單車旅行內容。
role.en: Explored free hosting resources and set up and customized my personal blog. Studied PHP, MySQL, HTML5, and CSS, and organized technology and cycling content.

body.zh: 高二開始使用 Blogger，大二進一步接觸 WordPress，使用網路上的免費資源建置 zhuyin.epizy.com。網頁學習包含 PHP、MySQL、HTML5 與 CSS。
body.en: I started using Blogger in high school and moved into WordPress at university, building zhuyin.epizy.com with freely available resources. My web studies included PHP, MySQL, HTML5, and CSS.
